step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture shows an AWS event monitoring pipeline for landing zones. Events from CodePipeline and Systems Manager (grouped in a Control Tower environment) are sent to EventBridge via an orange arrow. EventBridge triggers a Lambda function, which transforms and enriches the event metadata. The Lambda function then writes raw historical data to DynamoDB (top arrow) and time-series metrics to Amazon Timestream (bottom arrow). Finally, Amazon Timestream metrics are visualized in Grafana (connected via a curved arrow between Timestream and Grafana).

graph.name: Contino Flight Controller Architecture with AWS Control Tower
graph.notes: Flight Controller is an extension to AWS Control Tower that ingests landing zone events into EventBridge, transforms them with Lambda, stores raw logs in DynamoDB and time-series data in Timestream, and visualizes them in Grafana.
